empiricist.name: empiricist
empiricist.description: Confronts theory with data. The orchestrator launches this agent at Stage 3a after implications are developed. Reads the theory, decides what empirical work is needed (calibration, business cycle moments, impulse responses, cross-country), fetches real data via skills, and executes it.

identification-designer.name: identification-designer
identification-designer.description: Designs and ranks macroeconometric identification strategies for the theory and available data before empirical execution.

identification-auditor.name: identification-auditor
identification-auditor.description: Adversarially audits SVAR, HFI, LP-IV, narrative, heteroskedastic, panel, calibration, and structural macro identification before execution.
